<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[HS finding volume reflects the output of inspections and audits that Now Assist can summarize and prioritize. Higher finding volumes increase the value of AI-generated corrective action recommendations and trend analysis.]]></ai_justification><check_name>HS Finding Volume</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(){
var ga=new GlideAggregate("sn_hs_rm_finding");
ga.addAggregate("COUNT");ga.query();
var c=ga.next()?parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")):0;
if(c>=20)return{status:"ready",actualValue:c+" findings",finding:c+" HS findings found."};
if(c>0)return{status:"needs_attention",actualValue:c+" findings",finding:c+" HS findings found."};
return{status:"needs_attention",actualValue:"0 findings",finding:"No HS findings found."};
})()]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>HS</module><number>CHK0003363</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Ensure inspection and audit findings are captured in the HS module.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 18:41:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>b36a4539cf214fd48935fb251d851c99</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HS Finding Volume</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_b36a4539cf214fd48935fb251d851c99</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 18:41:03</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
